subject: Intro + demo coordination for OrbitConnect (SI-led inbound)
messages:
From: Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@orbit-partners.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbitconnect.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: OrbitConnect inbound lead — can we schedule a short demo?

Hi Sofia,

Hope youre well. Quick intro: Im Jasmine at Orbit Partners (SI) — we referred one of our customers, AcmeCorp (Harper Lee), who signed up for a sandbox on Redwoods self-serve flow and is interested in a short, technical demo focused on private deployment and cost controls.

High-level ask: could someone from the Redwood demo team run a 30–40 minute session next week to cover:
- Private deployment options (VPC / on-prem)
- Dedicated capacity and autoscaling behavior
- Cost controls: batching, quantization suggestions
- Next steps for a POC

Attached a one-pager with the customer context and a short list of technical reqs. Wed prefer an afternoon slot (US-Pacific) if possible. Luis (OrbitConnect) is the partner sponsor and Harper (AcmeCorp) is the primary prospect — included above.

Thanks — Jasmine
Partner Success, Orbit Partners
attachments: orbitconnect-prospect-brief.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@orbit-partners.com>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbitconnect.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrbitConnect inbound lead — can we schedule a short demo?

Hi Jasmine and Luis — thanks for the intro and the brief. Welcome, Harper.

Wed be happy to run a focused demo next week. Quick questions to make sure we tailor it:
- Is the Acme workload expected to run in their Azure tenancy (VNet) or do they want us to demo our hosted + private options?
- Any hard latency SLOs or token-rate targets we should prepare for?
- Will they need to evaluate embeddings / reranking as part of the same session?

Tentative availability (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-10: 1:00–1:45pm or 3:00–3:45pm
- Wed 2026-11-11: 10:00–10:45am

Ill pencil Ben on the 3:00pm slot; he can cover the technical walk-through and deployment options. Monica (CS lead) is looped for follow-up on POC logistics. Please let me know which of these works or share a preferred time.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | Make inference predictable and economical
phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbitconnect.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@orbit-partners.com>, Harper Lee <harper.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrbitConnect inbound lead — can we schedule a short demo?

Thanks Sofia — all good questions. Quick answers:
- Acme wants the demo to show both hosted and private (theyre evaluating which to choose).
- Latency SLO: target 150ms median for short responses, occasional longer for long-form. Token throughput: ~600k tokens/day initially.
- Embeddings: yes, theyd like a short overview but main focus is serving and cost controls.

Harper — would 3:00–3:45pm PST on Tue 2026-11-10 work for you?

Cheers,
Luis
Solutions Lead, OrbitConnect

From: Harper Lee <harper.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbitconnect.com>, Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@orbit-partners.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrbitConnect inbound lead — can we schedule a short demo?

Hi all — 3:00–3:45pm PST on Tue 11/10 works for me. Thanks for coordinating.

A couple of attachments from our side: a short technical requirements spreadsheet and our expected peak usage matrix (I attached acmecorp-technical-reqs.xlsx).

Looking forward — Harper
Head of Platform Engineering, AcmeCorp

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@orbit-partners.com>, Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@orbitconnect.com>, Harper Lee <harper.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + demo coordination for OrbitConnect (SI-led inbound)

Thanks — meeting confirmed for Tue 2026-11-10 15:00–15:45 PST. Ill prepare:
- Short slide deck (10 min) showing Hosted vs Private deployment flow and control plane UX
- Live demo: Dedicated pool behavior + autoscaling demo (15–20 min)
- Cost controls: batching & quantization examples + expected unit economics for the traffic profile
- Quick Q&A and next steps for POC pickup

Action items for Sofia / Monica: please share any specific customer prompts or redlines you want covered. Ill upload the deck and the demo checklist to the shared drive and send the calendar invite.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
